name: Kiryuuin Rindou
source:
The student council president who is the daughter of a politician. Rindou excels in all school subjects except for sex ed, which is why she is in the Fuzzy Rose Colors class. Her father loves historical dramas, and as such, she has watched a lot of them ever since she was young. Because of that, she often uses old-fashioned language, especially when referring to herself.

Rindou has a complex about her short stature, especially because she gets treated like a kid. The other students also see her as some sort of a mascot character. Despite her big attitude and strong front, Rindou is secretly a masochist.
